## Walkthrough Rule

Review one consequential question at a time. The immediate question is whether
the content-bound `SCI-FRUIT-ODQ-001F-DISPOSITION-B-R0.8` record is accepted as
final. A short paraphrase is insufficient, and in-principle approval is not
closure. After closure, all separate lane-launch decisions in the repaired
frame remain required. Record each answer in a separate dated owner-decision
artifact without rewriting earlier records and propagate only its authorized
consequences.
